text:
ajay: Heads up — flight just got delayed, need to swap out of tonight's primary window. I can cover until 23:00 UTC but then I'm offline. Sorry for the short notice.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager assigned: P1 latency-surge-prod — 1 pager, 1 minute SLA. Details: increased 95p latency on /v1/generate, region us-west. Incident page: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0427

sara: I can take primary from 23:00-07:00 UTC. Can shadow from 22:30. @kevin you good for secondary tonight after 00:30?

kevin: Yup I can take secondary and stay on-call until 08:00 UTC. I'll be available via phone too.

maria: Thanks team. Quick checklist before handoff: update pager rotations, post runbook link, check canary traffic routing, and verify KV cache hit rate.

ajay: Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/oncall/latency-surge. Steps I usually run before leaving:
```
1) curl -s https://telemetry/api/metrics?service=inference | jq '.latency.p95'
2) kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=runtime -o wide
3) kubectl logs -n inference deployment/runtime --tail=200 | grep -i error
4) rwdctl canary show --svc inference-usw --traffic-percent
```
If you see p95 > 400ms, bump canary down to 0 and open INC.

sara: Got it. I'll run the checks at 22:45 and post results here. Can you confirm the quick mitigation commands if we see KV cache misses spike?

ajay: Mitigation I use:
```
# point canary away from sota model variant quickly
rwdctl canary set --svc inference-usw --variant v1-quant --traffic 0
# if underprovisioned, scale runtime pool
rwdctl pool scale --name inference-usw-pool --replicas 6
# temporary disable some heavy hooks
rwdctl config set inference.experimental_hooks false
```
These are safe short-term. For scale ops contact infra-scaling (pager: infra-scaling).

incident-bot: Update: latency-surge-prod now stable-ish; 95p down from 620ms -> 310ms over last 5m. No new errors in logs.

kevin: I'll stand by to promote to primary if you need to drop earlier. Do we want to set an explicit handoff time in the rota tool?

ajay: Yes — please set handoff at 23:00 UTC. I will mark in rota and annotate in the incident page.

sara: Quick verification ran at 22:47: p95=295ms, KV hit=94%, canary traffic 12%. CPU across runtime pods avg 62%. Posting runbook excerpt below for quick reference.

maria: Nice. Two additional pointers:
- If canary traffic is >10% and latency >350ms, target variant fallback to `v1-quant-safe`
- Check `rwd-metrics:inflight_requests` — if >200 across cluster, consider throttling non-essential batch jobs.

sara: Done — rota updated, pinned handoff at 23:00 UTC. I've also added a note on the incident page: "shadowing from 22:30, full prim at 23:00".

ajay: Thanks @sara, @kevin, @maria. Leaving Slack open for a few mins in case anything pops. If you need me earlier ping mobile. :phone: :thumbsup:

kevin: Acknowledged. I'll keep an eye on traces and take over if you sign out early.

sara: Taking primary at 23:00. Will post a short status update at 23:15. :eyes:

incident-bot: Note: handover scheduled — Primary change requested by ajay at 7670012345. Auto-checklist triggered: telemetry snapshot, runbook read, escalation contacts verified.

ajay: One last thing — ticket for customer-facing comms if latency spikes again: please coordinate with @support and add the canned message from runbook before escalations.

maria: Logged. Support on standby.

sara: OK all set. Handoff confirmed. Good luck y'all. :rocket:
